title: Design: Other customers' dropdown leaves out the inactive term
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop switched off Net 50, and you compare a Net 30 customer's term dropdown with the design.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • {Customer-A} is on Net 30, and Net 50 is deactivated.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST D-41 Customer.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide, at 100% zoom.
    For example: a maximised window on a 1440 x 900 screen.
  • The design picture ct-p6-07-any-other-customer-s-picker.png is attached to this case; open it at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Starting screen: the customer page of {Customer-A}.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the pencil on the customer card.
  2. Click the "Credit Terms" box.
  3. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "Edit Customer" window opens.
  • Step 2: the list shows the active terms only, "Net 30" highlighted, and neither "Net 50" nor "Net 50 (Inactive)" (as in ct-p6-07-any-other-customer-s-picker.png).
  • Step 3: at 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll; the layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S5-N2: “Inactive terms are never offered to a customer not already on them.”
